body: A flight/crouch that sees the SAME crime again (a body in sight) no longer re-rolls: the corpse refreshed Cower every perception cycle, so a cowering witness stayed crouched until the corpse despawned (30 s) and never reached 'cower_seconds elapsing'. Alternative kept-refresh + shorter flee_distance rejected (changes flight feel).

City gate picks the SPARSEST qualifying victim (fewest >=3 calm civilians within 40 m): picking the most crowded one passed 20/20 at 4.0 s under the old rules too (16-22 witnesses), a tautology for the fix.

Cower end rolls call_after_flee; on a miss it flees with about=None, but the corpse still in sight re-arms about=Body, so a cowerer gets a second roll at flight end. Accepted (a new flight from a body is a new witnessing); alternative: a declined-call marker, rejected as YAGNI.

call_after_flee 0.6 -> 0.8: on seeds 1000..1099 the street-kill gate measured 87/100 at 0.6, 91 at 0.7, 94 at 0.8, 95 at 1.0 (old rules 53). 0.8 keeps a real margin over the 85/100 floor; 0.7 rejected (91 sits near the floor, ~3% false RED on a reshuffle), 1.0 rejected (every fleer calls, adds 1 kill over 0.8).

Runtime wave probe resets heat to 0 the moment the first star appears: a 30 s watch at 1 star ended in Busted at 20 s (reset_wanted clears Crimes, dropped calls, and the loop then waited forever for cops). With heat 0 a second report of the same kill would show as a new +40 increment, so heat-once stays observable. Alternative (teleport the player away) rejected: it recycles the witnesses out of the bubble.
